item_name: Rothco G.I. Plus Rifle Cleaning Kit
item_short_desc: Ensure your rifle stays in prime condition with Rothco's Rifle Cleaning Kit. This compact kit is designed specifically for .223 and 5.56 caliber firearms. It includes essential tools like a .233 caliber and 5.56mm bore brush, chamber brush, and a 5-piece rod assembly. Additionally, this kit comes with a refillable oil bottle, allowing you to use your preferred gun oil (oil not included).
